arStrings.szText: {c_label}Lucky Hit:{/c} Shadow damage has up to a {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 1"|%|]{/c} chance to create a toxic explosion that applies {c_number}[(Owner.Weapon_Damage_Min_Total + Owner.Weapon_Damage_Delta_Total) * Affix."Static Value 2"]{/c} Poisoning damage over {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 0"]{/c} seconds to the target and surrounding enemies. You deal {c_random}[Affix_Value_1|x%|]{/c} increased Non-Physical damage to enemies affected by this Poison.
Shadow Damage can apply Poisoning to enemies that increases your Non-Physical damage to them by {c_random}[Affix_Value_1|x%|]{/c}.
